title: A customer paid with my own debit card
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American house at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: A customer just paid with my debit card.

scenes.narration: A customer just paid with my debit card.

shots.prompt: gas station convenience store counter at night, fluorescent light, empty aisle, a bank card lying on the counter, no person visible

scenes.narration: It was 2:40 a.m. I knew that card. The scratch on the corner. My name. Even the bent edge from my wallet.

shots.prompt: close up of a bank card with a scratched corner under harsh fluorescent light, text not legible

scenes.narration: My card was in my back pocket. I checked. It was there. Two identical cards. Same scratch. Same bent edge.

shots.prompt: hand pulling a bank card from a back pocket, gas station counter, fluorescent light

scenes.narration: The man wore a gray hoodie. He never looked up. He only said one word. Pump nine.

shots.prompt: man in a gray hoodie seen from behind at a gas station counter, hood up, fluorescent light, face hidden

scenes.narration: I glanced at the monitor. The security camera showed the counter. Empty. Nobody there. Just the hum of the freezer and the flickering lights.

shots.prompt: security camera monitor showing an empty gas station counter, grainy black and white

scenes.narration: But he stood right in front of me. Close enough to smell the rain on him. His hands were shaking. Or maybe mine were.

shots.prompt: dark gas station window at night with rain, reflection of a hooded figure, no face

scenes.narration: The receipt printed itself. See you tomorrow, it said. Behind the register.

shots.prompt: thermal receipt paper curling out of a printer in a dim gas station, text blurred

overlays.text: See you tomorrow. Behind the register.

scenes.narration: I looked up at the monitor again. He was behind the register. And I was standing where he had stood.

shots.prompt: security camera monitor showing a hooded figure behind a gas station register and a second figure at the counter, grainy, no faces

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you keep the card, or run?

shots.prompt: gas station convenience store counter at night, fluorescent light, empty aisle, a bank card lying on the counter, no person visible
